name: Facet
text: Ship EXCAVA with a dark theme by default but include a one-click toggle to light mode. This keeps the interface crisp and readable in low light while respecting user preference—matching the competitive analysis where dark themes dominate but light themes remain an option. The trade-off is a slight increase in UI complexity, but the benefit of immediate comfort for most users outweighs the minor friction.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Defaulting to dark mode ignores users who switch themes frequently—it’s no better than forcing system preference. A persistent toggle that remembers user choice is the only way to respect true preference. Settle it with a week-long A/B test measuring theme-switch frequency and user satisfaction.
